g1-implement.title: Per-stream raw instrument characterization: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G1. Build a read-only characterization script in scripts/ (e.g. scripts/characterize_telemetry_instruments.py) that, over a documented selection of >=6 sessions spanning >=2 seasons (2022-2025 deep cache, mixing race + quali + >=1 wet or red-flagged session), loads RAW streams ONLY via the 0a offline_loader (car_data ~240Hz, pos_data ~10Hz; NEVER get_telemetry; pos_data in DECIMETRES, x0.1 to metres) and measures PER STREAM: (1) sampling-interval distribution (median dt, IQR, tail, gap/dropout rate, per-batch Source breakdown); (2) position quantization step (X/Y/Z least-significant increment, in decimetres and metres); (3) Z-channel quality verdict (range, variance, plausibility vs flat-track expectation); (4) per-channel noise covariance for the smooth channels (Speed, X, Y, Z) estimated as residual variance against a local smooth fit. Checkpoint per-session results to JSON under .agent-work/issue-447/evidence/ so a continuation can resume. Document session selection and its rationale. Set utf-8 in any captured python subprocess env. Run on a sufficient subset to prove the script works end-to-end and produce the real per-session numbers (foreground; long compute runs in the commander/crew, never backgrounded). Dispatch a constellation-implementer subagent. Wait for and integrate the IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with per-session characterization JSON on disk and the script runnable

g2-implement.title: Time-tag jitter model + inter-stream offset stability: implement
g2-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G2. Build a read-only script in scripts/ (e.g. scripts/characterize_timetag_jitter.py) reusing the 0a cross_residual primitive and offline_loader to quantify, over the SAME documented session set as G1: (1) TIME-TAG JITTER magnitude per stream (residuals of SessionTime against a smooth/expected-cadence fit, and against sector-crossing constraints from DB sector truth via db_truth_loader) with a distribution; (2) classify the time-tag ERROR MODEL as one of bias / random-walk / per-batch (test for per-Source-batch structure, autocorrelation, drift) with the evidence for the chosen class; (3) INTER-STREAM clock-offset stability: fit per-lap and per-session inter-stream offsets (reuse diagnose_cross_residual), and characterize whether the offset is an ESTIMABLE STABLE bias or per-lap WANDER (mean, spread, per-lap range, autocorrelation) — this directly resolves 0a finding F2; (4) per-channel noise covariances refined for the GO/NO-GO. Checkpoint per-session JSON under .agent-work/issue-447/evidence/. Compute the reduced chi-square values the 0a covariance gate would see given the measured noise model, to inform the band recommendation (F1). Dispatch a constellation-implementer subagent. Wait for and integrate the IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g3-implement.title: Measurement-model document + GO/NO-GO evidence pack: implement
g3-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G3. Author docs/physics/measurement_model.md from the G1+G2 evidence: per-stream sampling-interval distributions, position quantization steps, Z-channel verdict, time-tag jitter magnitude + explicit error model (bias/random-walk/per-batch, chosen with evidence), per-channel noise covariances, inter-stream offset stability (estimable bias vs wander). Every number traceable to its script + session. Then OPERATIONALIZE the GO/NO-GO gate: state the measured criteria for 'offsets estimable' AND 'cross-residuals bounded' BEFORE applying them, apply them to the measured values, and write a clearly-labeled RECOMMENDATION (GO / NO-GO / marginal-with-analysis) for the human — present marginal as marginal (Honest-Null clause). Include: the recommended covariance-gate chi-square band with the noise-model justification (resolves F1), and the s_finish free-anchor DESIGN DECISION with its evidence (resolves F3). Add a 'Last verified' line. If any durable noise-model reader is warranted, place it in src/preprocessing/ (not evo) with a unit test; otherwise document why the script-only artifact suffices. Dispatch a constellation-implementer subagent. Wait for and integrate the IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
